headline: Trade is mutual exchange—giving what you have to get what you need
universal_truth: Exchange creates value; both sides gain when trade is voluntary and fair
fun_facts: Trade has existed for at least 150,000 years—it's deeply human
Long-distance trade networks existed in ancient times across continents
Specialization and trade together explain much of human prosperity
discussion_questions: What do you trade—goods, services, time?
When does trade feel fair and when does it feel exploitative?
How has trade shaped your life?

hook.script: You have something I want. I have something you want. Trade solves this—we each give what we have less need for and get what we need more. This simple exchange is foundation of economy.

cliff.script: Why not just make everything yourself? Why depend on others through trade?

options.text: Trade enables specialization—instead of everyone doing everything poorly, people get good at specific things; through exchange, everyone accesses what others do best; trade multiplies capability
options.response: Yes. You can't be expert at everything. Trade lets you focus on what you do best and access others' expertise. This division of labor is why economies produce more than individuals could alone.

options.text: Trade is just about getting stuff
options.response: Getting things is the surface, but trade enables the entire structure of specialized, productive society...

fact1.title: Value Creation
fact1.script: Trade creates value. Before exchange, each person has something they value less. After, each has something they value more. Both sides gain—that's why voluntary trade happens.

fact2.title: Trust Required
fact2.script: Trade requires trust. Will you deliver what you promised? Will I pay? Trade works when people trust each other. Contracts, laws, and reputation systems all support trading trust.

fact3.title: Fair Exchange
fact3.script: Not all trades are equal. Power imbalances can make exchanges exploitative. Fair trade means both parties have options and information. Unfair trade is one-sided extraction.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Exchange creates value. Both sides gain when trade is voluntary and fair. Participate in and honor fair exchange.

outro.script: That's Day 337. Tomorrow, we'll explore how money works—the tool that makes trade easier. Until then, notice how trade structures your daily life.

growTrack.title: Trade Mapping - What Do You Exchange?
growTrack.activity: Map the trades in your life: What do you give (work, money, goods)? What do you receive? Which trades feel fair? Which feel unequal? How might you improve the terms of your exchanges?
